gloss: many, a great number of, numerous

definitions.gloss: many, a great number of, numerous
definitions.explanation: A large number of something. Used to express that there are very many instances, items, or examples of something.

examples.japanese: {数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: He left behind a great number of works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Numerous tourists from around the world visit.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野鳥|やちょう}→野鳥：14497_yachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生息|せいそく}→生息：13542_seisoku⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A great many species of wild birds inhabit this area.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the pattern {数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (many/numerous + noun). More literary and formal than ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧ (many, a lot). Also read as あまた in a more literary register, though {数多|かずおお}く is the standard modern reading. Can function as an adverb or a noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: many, a great number of
- {数多|かずおお}く⟦{存在|そんざい}する→存在する：17185_sonzaisuru⟧: to exist in large numbers
- {数多|かずおお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: numerous experiences

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: many, a lot (general, everyday)
- ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧: a large number (formal, quantitative)
- おびただしい: enormous, vast (even more emphatic)
